title: Hackers Reportedly Used Internal AI Tool in $6.34 Billion Breach of Cryptocurrency Exchange Binance
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance reported that attackers used a compromised internal AI tool to gain control of additional developer workstations before using stolen credentials to reach wallet-signing infrastructure. The exchange said approximately $6.34 billion in digital assets were affected, of which $2.85 billion was frozen or intercepted. The FBI attributed the attack to North Korean hackers. The precise AI-tool exploit mechanism was not disclosed.
